buffers.title: Buffers
buffers.note: buffer.h was removed in libxml2 2.12; the xmlBuffer API survives deprecated in tree.h and remains exported.

sax1.title: SAX1
sax1.note: SAX.h hosts the SAX1 handler struct; the SAX1 parse entry points are declared in parser.h. Membership is prefix-based.

html-parser.title: HTML parser
html-parser.plan: HTML behavior actually targeted by upstream

xpath-internals.title: XPath internals (visible via API behavior)
xpath-internals.plan: XPath internals visible through API behavior

xlink.title: XLink
xlink.note: xlink.h functions are exported but undocumented (absent from the Doxygen public inventory).

globals.title: Globals (defaults, error context)
globals.note: The default-value accessors are declared across several headers (globals.h, parserInternals.h, tree.h); membership is by explicit name.

modules.title: Modules/plugins
modules.plan: modules/plugins if present in applicable eras

legacy.title: Legacy/deprecated interfaces
legacy.note: Legacy 1.x/2.0-era entry points. The DOCB parser family (xmlDocb*, xmlParseDocTypeDecl-era DOCB paths) was removed from libxml2 in 2.12 and is historical surface only; it is tracked by the historical epoch atlases.

xslt-numbering.title: Numbering
xslt-numbering.note: numbersInternals.h has no Clang-AST function records; membership is by explicit name.

xslt-namespace-alias.title: Namespace alias
xslt-namespace-alias.note: namespaces.h has no Clang-AST function records; membership is by explicit name.

xslt-exports.title: Exported internals relied upon by consumers
xslt-exports.plan: all exported internals historically relied upon by consumers

exslt-registry.title: EXSLT registration surface
exslt-registry.plan: all historically shipped modules and registrations
